turnkey.title: Turn-Key Solution

brand.title: Your Brand, Our Tech
brand.desc: Fully custom-branded cards with your logo, colors, and design. Your users see your brand — powered by our proven security infrastructure.

whatYouGain.title: Six reasons to
whatYouGain.mysteryDesc: This one's best explained in person. We'll let you discover it yourself — but trust us, it's worth the conversation.

revenue.title: New Revenue Streams
revenue.desc: Turn your brand into an on-chain revenue engine. Every user interaction within your ecosystem becomes a monetization opportunity — with fees flowing back to you across integrated financial services and third-party connections. Net-positive ROI, from day one.

onboarding.title: User Onboarding
onboarding.desc: A familiar card format removes the barrier to Web3 entry. No cables required — just tap. FIDO2-secured NFC makes self-custody as simple as a payment, bringing any user onchain under 30 secs.

retention.title: User Retention, LTV & Engagement
retention.desc: Hardware ownership creates a physical bond between your user and your brand. Tap-to-sign transactions, dApp connectivity, and multichain access keep users active, engaged, and coming back — long after the first interaction.

exposure.title: Brand Exposure
exposure.desc: From fully branded card wallet and packaging to a custom-domain front-end (wallet.yourbrand.com / brandedwallet.xyz) and your own AppStore / Play Market listing — your identity is present at every touchpoint. On the desk, in the hand, and on the screen.

product.title: Product Offering
product.desc: Expand what your business delivers. Embed the wallet interface into your existing product, make a cross-software integration or launch it as a standalone branded solution — hardware-backed, multichain-ready, and built for stablecoins, RWAs, DID verification, NFTs, token-gated access and even CBDCs.

useCases.label: Use Cases

useCases.description: From exchanges to ecosystems, our white-label solution adapts to your needs.

exchanges.title: Crypto Exchanges
exchanges.desc: Offer branded hardware wallets as a premium add-on for your users. Increase retention and reduce withdrawal-related support tickets.

ecosystems.desc: Distribute branded cards to your community. Perfect for ecosystem grants, conference giveaways, and developer incentive programs.

projects.title: Token Projects

tokens.label: Tokens

connectivity.label: Connectivity

ecosystem.title: Ecosystem Product

techyMerch.desc: Card-as-merch for events, launches, and community building. Branded hardware your users actually use daily — not another t-shirt that sits in a drawer. Real utility meets premium brand presence.

standalone.desc: Launch a complete wallet business under your brand. Your domain, your app listing, your revenue stream. We handle manufacturing, provisioning, and infrastructure — you focus on growth.

benefits.title: Partnership Benefits
